name: Midway University
academic_ranking: Midway University is a small private university in Midway, Kentucky, founded in 1847. It offers undergraduate and graduate programs with a focus on nursing, business, education, equine studies, and health sciences. Small class sizes and a low student-to-faculty ratio; historically women's-focused, now coeducational at the undergraduate level.
financial_aid: Midway University markets itself as one of the most affordable private universities in the region. Financial aid includes academic and need-based aid, plus NAIA athletic scholarships. Exact annual tuition figure not confirmed from a primary source during research (checked midway.edu 2026-07); left null rather than estimated.
facilities_notes: Softball plays home games at William G. Clark Memorial Field in Midway, KY (confirmed via gomidwayeagles.com softball schedule/facilities pages, 2026-07).
program_reputation: NAIA program competing in the River States Conference. Full coaching staff and 31-player roster maintained for the 2026 season.
